 November SSI payment dates are changing for some recipients
 Samantha Neely and Sarah Moore, USA TODAY NETWORK - Florida 2026년 10월 28일 수 오후 2:10 UTC 0 The final wave of Social Security payments for October will be distributed this week, and the November Supplemental Security Income payment will also go out this week — earlier than usual.
 Florida Social Security recipients can expect their last October payment on Oct. 28.
 A few days later, on Friday, Oct. 30, Supplemental Security Income (SSI) recipients receive their payments, earlier than usual since checks are typically sent on the first of each month.
 The Social Security Administration pays Social Security benefits to retired workers, people with disabilities and survivors. The Supplemental Security Income program is also part of the SSA and provides benefits to those with limited or no income or resources, those aged 65 or older, and those with a qualifying disability.
 Why are Supplemental Security Income payments going out this week?
 SSI beneficiaries will receive their checks earlier. Checks will be delivered on Friday, Oct. 30, rather than the regularly scheduled date, the first of each month, because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday.
 Advertisement
 When will I see my Social Security payments in November?
 Here are the payment dates for Social Security checks in November:
 Wednesday, Nov. 10, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between the 1st and 10th.
 Wednesday, Nov. 18, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between the 11th and 20th.
 Wednesday, Nov. 25, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between the 21st and 31st.
 When does the cost-of-living adjustment go into effect?
 SSI and Social Security recipients will receive a 3.6% increase in their benefits in 2027.
 SSI payments will increase starting Dec. 31, 2026, while Social Security benefits will see the change in January 2027, according to the Social Security Administration .
